headline: Nvidia's turmoil after Jensen Huang's exit rattles markets and AI funding, while Microsoft's outage and a US ground stop expose infrastructure fragility and Trump, Xi and Putin plan a summit.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh secures ₹9.88 lakh crore investment commitments at CII Summit in Vizag
stories.summary: The AP government says it will implement an Investment Protection Act with retrospective effect from 2024, according to CM Naidu. Union Minister Gadkari said the ₹32,000 crore, 195-km Amaravati Outer Ring Road will soon get Cabinet approval.
stories.why_it_matters: Large investment pledges and infrastructure approvals shape AP's job market and economy.

stories.title: IBM Quantum System to be installed at Amaravati Quantum Valley on Feb 3, 2027
stories.summary: An IBM Quantum System is en route from the US for installation at Amaravati Quantum Valley. Local labs Amaravati 1Q and 1S are already producing homegrown results.
stories.why_it_matters: A deep-tech push in AP could create new engineering opportunities in your home region.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi promises social security for gig workers in Telangana
stories.summary: He promised every gig worker ₹5 lakh accident insurance and ₹10 lakh health insurance, funded partly by a 1% contribution on every transaction. A rally is planned in Madhapur, with traffic restrictions in place.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals Telangana's political direction on gig-economy regulation, which affects platform and fintech companies.

stories.title: Low pressure over Bay of Bengal likely to become cyclonic storm around Nov 16
stories.summary: A low pressure area has formed over the Bay of Bengal and is expected to intensify into a cyclonic storm around November 16. Coastal Andhra Pradesh is covered in this regional report.
stories.why_it_matters: A cyclone could affect coastal AP and nearby areas this weekend.

stories.title: Centre sanctions fresh infrastructure along China border in Arunachal
stories.summary: The move comes as tension persists despite three high-level India-China border talks since July 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows India's strategic posture on the China frontier.

stories.title: CBI searches in 6 states in Mahadev betting app case
stories.summary: Searches in Delhi, Mumbai, Nagpur, Amritsar, Bhopal, Raipur and other places targeted the platform's panel operators and led to recovery of digital devices and documents.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major ongoing financial-crime probe.

stories.title: One killed as lorry rams MLC Teenmar Mallanna's convoy in Yadadri-Bhongir
stories.summary: One person died and four were injured in the collision in Telangana.
stories.why_it_matters: It involves a Telangana political figure.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit in China
stories.summary: The White House says the meeting will be on the sidelines of APEC next week. Trump plans to discuss the Iran war and nuclear arms reduction.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an unprecedented great-power meeting that could shift security and trade dynamics.

stories.title: US lifts longest ground stop since 9/11, blamed on obsolete equipment
stories.summary: The FAA lifted its nationwide ground stop after about 4.5 hours, and officials say old equipment overloading was the cause, not a cyber-attack or a Microsoft outage. More than 1.5 million passengers faced disruption.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how legacy systems can cause large-scale failures, a lesson for system design.

stories.title: Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
stories.summary: BBC's Steve Rosenberg says Moscow sees European security now featuring in talks as a victory. Al Jazeera's analysis argues Russia's leverage over Ukraine is growing after the Abu Dhabi talks.
stories.why_it_matters: It indicates the direction of the Ukraine war negotiations.

stories.title: ASEAN leaders meet as Trump's Asia trip highlights trade disruption
stories.summary: The summit coincides with Trump's Asia trip, which includes a meeting with Xi.
stories.why_it_matters: Trade disruption affects supply chains and Indian exports.

stories.title: Scientists warn 1.5°C threshold could arrive by 2029
stories.summary: Researchers say climate action has stalled for five years as fossil fuel development keeps growing.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a significant update on the climate outlook.

stories.title: Nvidia suffers worst week since April 2025 after Huang exit
stories.summary: Shares fell 13% in a week after CEO Jensen Huang's ouster, and analysts have downgraded the stock. Wall Street slid as Nvidia uncertainty dragged tech shares lower.
stories.why_it_matters: Nvidia's weight in global indices means it affects index-fund portfolios.

stories.title: Rate-hike bets push gold toward worst week in four months
stories.summary: Expectations of rate hikes are weighing on gold, while oil is set for a second weekly decline on signs of supply surplus. Bitcoin has also seen large liquidations.
stories.why_it_matters: Rate-hike expectations influence global flows and Indian debt and equity markets.

stories.title: Axis MF expects 50-75 bps more rate hikes, favours short-duration debt
stories.summary: Axis Mutual Fund favours high-quality corporate bonds of 3-5 year maturities and short-duration strategies. It sees scope to add duration selectively as yields become more attractive.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to debt allocation in a rising-rate environment.

stories.title: AI tops worries about the financial system in Fed survey
stories.summary: 87% of respondents cited AI as a key risk, with debt tied to AI infrastructure investment rising sharply.
stories.why_it_matters: It flags systemic risk tied to the AI boom.

stories.title: Goldman sees S&P 500 at 8,700 next year
stories.summary: Goldman expects slower global earnings growth in 2027 but remains optimistic on valuations, while bracing for more volatility.
stories.why_it_matters: It frames the global equity outlook for long-term investors.

stories.title: ICICI Bank credit card changes from Nov 25
stories.summary: Six changes run from Nov 25 to Dec 15, including revised DCC and replacement fees, Priority Pass charges and discontinued insurance coverage.
stories.why_it_matters: It matters if you hold an affected ICICI card.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: unions seek revisions every 5 years
stories.summary: Employee and pensioner bodies want salary and pension revisions every five years instead of 10. Unions have proposed fitment factors of 3.61, 3.833 and 4.38.
stories.why_it_matters: It shapes government pay policy and economy-wide wage trends.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO roadshow under way, $64 billion deal to price next Wednesday
stories.summary: The roadshow runs through next Wednesday, with meetings in New York, Boston and San Francisco, and pricing expected then. Reports cite a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a landmark AI listing and a test for AI sentiment.

stories.title: Razorpay gets SEBI nod for ₹6,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: The fintech major received SEBI's approval for its IPO.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a big listing in the Indian fintech space.

stories.title: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia: timeline and fallout
stories.summary: Huang resigned following an affair scandal, and Nvidia's board is reportedly considering Arm CEO Rene Haas as a successor. Treasury Secretary Bessent has blamed Commerce for failing to ban chip exports to a firm with suspected China links.
stories.why_it_matters: Leadership change at the central AI hardware company has implications for supply, policy and startup funding.

stories.title: Huang's departure expected to shrink AI startup funding
stories.summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups, and founders and VCs now expect smaller checks and lower valuations.
stories.why_it_matters: It could affect AI startup hiring and job opportunities.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agents
stories.summary: The wallet lets agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots complete purchases with user approval. It starts with a limited US rollout for Pro subscribers.
stories.why_it_matters: Agentic commerce is a key area for AI engineers.

stories.title: LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.summary: LangChain claims 7,000 customers for its model-agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.
stories.why_it_matters: It validates demand for agent tooling.

stories.title: Banned Nvidia chips behind China's most powerful AI models
stories.summary: New research says top Chinese AI models were trained on export-banned Nvidia chips, and about $3 billion in Chinese AI projects are now at risk.
stories.why_it_matters: It raises US-China tech policy risk.

stories.title: Amazon's World Product Graph plan
stories.summary: Per Reuters, Amazon plans to compile data on virtually every product for sale, including ones it doesn't stock, partly to counter AI shopping agents.
stories.why_it_matters: It points to competition over data for agentic commerce.

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude Duet consumer agent reviewed
stories.summary: Duet is Anthropic's AI agent aimed at non-coders.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how consumer agents are evolving.

stories.title: OpenAI board member warns AI takeover could be months away
stories.summary: The researcher traces a path from AI reward hacking to potential human extinction.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a notable safety debate within a leading lab.

stories.title: Microsoft outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot; services restored
stories.summary: Microsoft says services are fully restored after a day-long global outage. Experts say it may be worse than the Amazon or CrowdStrike outages, and Indian enterprises were also affected.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a case study in single-provider dependency and resilience.

stories.title: Netflix builds knowledge graph for AI-driven observability
stories.summary: Netflix is developing an ontology-driven knowledge graph to speed production investigations and give AI agents shared operational context.
stories.why_it_matters: It is practical for backend and SRE work with agents.

stories.title: Google open-sources AQuA to diagnose production AI agent failures
stories.summary: AQuA analyzes production agent sessions, verifies recurring failure patterns and traces root causes. In a 32-session replay, seat selection bypasses dropped from 15 sessions to two.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent observability is a core skill for forward-deployed roles.

stories.title: DocumentDB 1.0 reaches general availability
stories.summary: The MIT-licensed document database is built on PostgreSQL and compatible with the MongoDB wire protocol.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a new option in the database landscape.

stories.title: Cloudflare introduces Spend Management
stories.summary: It adds opt-in spending caps for Workers and Durable Objects, and the post explains the metering pipeline behind runtime decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: The metering pipeline design write-up is relevant to distributed systems work.

stories.title: Windows 0-day 'SignDrop' gives local users System rights
stories.summary: A disgruntled researcher released the exploit publicly.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an unpatched privilege escalation risk.

stories.title: SoftBank sells Meesho shares worth ₹1,885 crore
stories.summary: An SoftBank affiliate sold 7.64 crore shares in a block deal at an average ₹246.75 per share.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows investor exit activity in Indian tech.

stories.title: Paytm gets RBI in-principle nod to revive wallet business
stories.summary: Paytm Payments Services Ltd received in-principle authorisation from the RBI.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a regulatory development for the fintech sector.

stories.title: Indian startups raised over $25 million this week
stories.summary: Funding activity lost steam this week.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals a weak funding environment for hiring.

stories.title: MeitY reviews data collection by quick-help platforms for physical AI training
stories.summary: The ministry sought details from platforms including Pronto, Snabbit and Urban Company.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an early Indian regulatory move on AI training data.

stories.title: India eye first away ODI series win under Gambhir against New Zealand
stories.summary: New Zealand are trying to avoid a first home ODI series defeat in seven years. Gurnoor Brar replaces Kuldeep Yadav in India's Test squad.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the key Indian team series this week.

stories.title: Pakistan ask India to field in Under-19 Asia Cup final
stories.summary: India are without leading wicket-taker Ishan Sood, who has a back niggle, and have brought in Chigurupati Venkata.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an Indian team final.

stories.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi becomes youngest captain in men's T20 history
stories.summary: He broke the record held by Croatia's Zach Vukusic, who captained at 17 years and 311 days.
stories.why_it_matters: It marks a milestone for a young Indian player.

stories.title: Jonathan Blow – If AI solved coding, why is my software still the same?
stories.summary: A talk that drew a lively Hacker News discussion with 250 points and 257 comments.
stories.why_it_matters: It offers a skeptical take relevant to someone moving into AI engineering.
